intel.title: [CISA KEV] SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN - SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-19868
廠商: SonicWall
產品: SonicOS SSLVPN
漏洞名稱: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
說明: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-20
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN 存在單因子身份驗證漏洞（CVE-2026-19868），可能允許攻擊者繞過 SAML 驗證控制與多因子驗證（MFA）。該漏洞已被 CISA 列入已遭利用漏洞清單（KEV）。經比對公司資產清冊，內部並未部署 SonicWall 相關產品或 VPN 設備。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
